Its note line is in, at 98fb59b7. The upstream remote was removed earlier on hv's TUI answer, since it named the public repository and the cut's pre-flight refused it; its config is saved at ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/st0011/upstream-remote-saved.txt. hv on it: 'It is the literal opposite of what I asked for, is attempting to solve a problem that doesn't exist, and doesn't even work anyway. We will be good to be rid of it.' The cut's record is kept at ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/st0011/cut-0.1.19-record.txt. Then read CI once per sha: AC-4.1 is amended for main's second Ubuntu run (hv's TUI answer, 18:43Z), so vc marks AC-4.1 from that read, and dc's WP04 closes then. Then the sweep per sweep-plan.md, then WP10 to WP14, which give the cache its first callers (vc's ruling under decision 102).
